$comment: Project hooks. Enforcement belongs in hooks, not prompts. The deps-guard PreToolUse hook enforces supply-chain checks deterministically; the tree-claim PreToolUse hook keeps a second session opened in the same directory from writing over the first, and sends it into its own worktree. The static+test quality gate is enforced by the reviewer subagent's Stop hook (see .claude/agents/reviewer.md) and by CI.
